support.name: S4
support.definition: selected_mask_ring64 intersect V30 intersect V44 intersect V70 intersect V100
support.Vnu: NSIDE64 parent cell valid iff all native children Q and U of that map are finite and differ from its exact BAD_DATA sentinel represented in native float32 before float64 conversion
support.native_cell_mapping: Native NESTED pixel -> NSIDE64 NESTED parent -> RING64 support lookup; map native NESTED Q/U values by exact permutation into native RING order
support.invalid_value: Parse actual BAD_DATA header; cast sentinel to float32, then convert to float64 for comparisons with converted native data. Also reject every nonfinite Q/U. No amplitude-based cut or inferred unseen-value threshold.

functional_bundle.x: All96 canonical coordinates,4 full STF sets and6 full24-coordinate pair contrasts retained; scalar score never substitutes
functional_bundle.Q: Derived deterministic full-carrier functional: Q_nu^2=sum_{ell=2,3}(||c^E_nu,ell||_2^2+||c^B_nu,ell||_2^2)/s_ell^2, with canonical real-harmonic Euclidean norms, s2=q0=1e-5K and s3=o0=1e-5K. Q_nu is the nonnegative square root; not an STF Frobenius score and never a replacement for the complete carrier.
functional_bundle.F_frequency: F_frequency_empirical(t)=1/4 sum_{nu in {30,44,70,100}} 1{Q_nu<=t}; explicit four-point counting measure, mass1/4 each. Descriptive computational frequency occupancy only; no physical/probabilistic sampling interpretation.
